title: Even When
goal: Use aun cuando + the subjunctive for a possibility and + the indicative for a fact, in formal speech and writing.

items: I can use aun cuando with the subjunctive for a possibility and with the indicative for a fact.
I can tell when aun cuando suits a serious promise better than aunque.
I can use the new words for principles and risk.
